title: Stanford's STORM prompting method in Claude
description:
Stanford's STORM prompting method in Claude — four prompts for research that doesn't make things up

Five expert perspectives, a contradiction audit, a synthesis brief, then Claude grades its own confidence and names its weakest claim — so you end up with something you can defend.

top_comments.text: The self-grading step at the end is the part most people skip, but it's genuinely where the quality jump happens — forcing the model to flag its weakest claim before you act on it is a much better safety net than just hoping the output is solid.
